name: Murine
text: Murine is an anglicized form of the name Muirenn Muncháem, mother of the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill.

attributes.attribute: name of Fionn mac Cumhaill's mother in English texts

okr.objective: Documents Murine as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Murine renders Muirenn Muncháem in English.
The name belongs to Fionn mac Cumhaill's mother.
